# 1.3fix

- Initial Minecraft `26.3` NeoForge release of **Saphyra Reborn** (ported with full feature parity from `26.2` `1.3fix`):
  - Adapted custom rendering pipelines (`com.mojang.renderpearl.api.pipeline.RenderPipeline`), `PoseStack.rotate(Axis, float)`, entity sync/invulnerability/swing APIs, `PushReaction.IGNORE_ENTITY`, inventory/drop `Prediction`, `CommandSourceStack`, and `ModConfig.Type.LOCAL` for `26.3`.
  - Updated all worldgen `template_pool` block ignore processors and loot table number providers (`minecraft:uniform`) plus `pack.mcmeta` for Minecraft `26.3`.
  - Includes all `1.3` Boss animation fixes and `1.3fix` highlight / GeckoLib 5 idle log fixes.

# 1.3fix

- 首次发布 **Saphyra Reborn** 的 Minecraft `26.3` NeoForge 版本（基于 `26.2` `1.3fix` 完整等价迁移）：
  - 完整适配 `26.3` 的 RenderPearl 渲染管线（`com.mojang.renderpearl.api.pipeline.RenderPipeline`）、`PoseStack.rotate(Axis, float)`、实体同步/无敌帧/挥手动画、`PushReaction.IGNORE_ENTITY`、物品栏/掉落 `Prediction`、`CommandSourceStack` 及 `ModConfig.Type.LOCAL`。
  - 同步更新全部结构模板池（`worldgen/template_pool`）忽略方块格式、战利品表数值提供器（显式声明 `minecraft:uniform`）及 `pack.mcmeta`。
  - 完整包含 `1.3` 全部 Boss 动画修复与 `1.3fix` 高亮崩溃及 GeckoLib 5 待机日志刷屏修复。
